verdict.rationale: The project README states that "Zero does not track, collect, or sell your data in any way," and the self-hosting option lets users run their own instance and control their data. Together these suggest there is no telemetry to opt out of, but this rests on a single vendor sentence with no documented telemetry setting or verification. Missing for 10: documented telemetry/analytics configuration or opt-out controls, detail on what data hosted AI features send to third parties, independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-tracking claim.
